claim: v3 detecting-insults with haiku on 8 roles + sonnet ONLY on coder also does NOT fix the malformed-submission failure. Same exact failure as X202/X209/X217: submission.csv missing the 'Comment' column. Medal=none (invalid_submission). Cost $6.81 total (coder=$4.24 the largest single role). With this fourth single-role-lift failure (X202 haiku-all, X209 sonnet-aggregator-only, X217 sonnet-designer-only, X218 sonnet-coder-only) all rejecting submission, the schema gate on v3 detecting-insults is established as MULTI-role: no single role lifted from haiku to sonnet is sufficient to fix the schema. The cost-savings hypothesis 'sonnet on one role + haiku on eight' is REFUTED for v3 text-classification (detecting subfamily).

support.grader_error: Submission should have an Comment column

scope: Single Phase 2 run. Concludes the single-role-lift series on detecting (X202/X209/X217/X218 all negative).

consolidated_findings.single_role_isolation_complete: All four logical single-role-lift candidates have been tested: haiku-all (X202), +sonnet-aggregator (X209), +sonnet-designer (X217), +sonnet-coder (X218). All four produced invalid_submission with cost in [$3.80, $6.81]. No single-role lift is sufficient on v3 text-classification.
consolidated_findings.implied_minimum_lift: Schema correctness on v3 detecting requires sonnet on AT LEAST TWO of {designer, coder, aggregator}. The 3 pairwise combinations and the all-three combination remain untested. X219 (sonnet-everywhere) is the upper bound and should produce a valid submission.
consolidated_findings.cost_observation: Sonnet-coder ($4.24, X218) is 5x more expensive than sonnet-aggregator ($0.34, X209) and sonnet-designer ($0.44, X217), because coder runs many more turns. Any minimum-lift policy that includes coder will be expensive on detecting; the cheaper minimal set if it exists would be {designer + aggregator}.

limitations: Pairwise combinations untested: {designer + aggregator}, {designer + coder}, {coder + aggregator}, and the all-three {designer + coder + aggregator}.
confidence: medium-high (4 consecutive failures form a strong pattern)

implications.schema_gate_resolution: MULTI-role on v3 text-classification detecting subfamily. The single-role-lift hypothesis space is exhausted.
follow_up_experiments: X219 (queued) — sonnet-everywhere on detecting. Upper bound: should produce valid submission and silver/gold tier. Anchors the cost-savings comparison.
If X219 succeeds: X220 candidate — sonnet on {designer + aggregator}, haiku on rest. Tests the cheapest two-role lift.
If X220 succeeds: minimum sonnet routing for detecting found.

next_actions: Continue to X219 (sonnet-everywhere) to establish the working baseline.
